translate each candidate set into its structural features (bounded/unbounded, contiguous/disconnected, centeredness) and compare against the theorem’s constraints

evaluate (III) [2,2] ∪ [3,3]: recognize it is a disconnected set (two isolated points), which cannot occur for an interval of convergence
evaluate (IV) (−∞,∞): recognize this corresponds to radius R=∞ and is valid
map the valid items ((I) and (IV)) to the provided answer choices and select option C
rationale: The work hinges on recalling and applying the structural rule for power series intervals of convergence (updating_using_knowledge) and decomposing each proposed set to check whether it matches those constraints (analyzing_data, evaluating_compliance).
